## Setup

```{python}
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder, StandardScaler
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split, GridSearchCV, StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import (
    accuracy_score, precision_score, recall_score,
    f1_score, roc_auc_score, average_precision_score,
    confusion_matrix, ConfusionMatrixDisplay
)

from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.neighbors import KNeighborsClassifier
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier, GradientBoostingClassifier
from sklearn.svm import SVC
from xgboost import XGBClassifier

RANDOM_STATE = 42
np.random.seed(RANDOM_STATE)

sns.set(style="whitegrid")
plt.rcParams["figure.figsize"] = (8, 5)
```

## Preprocessing / Feature Engineering

```{python}

y = data["Machine failure"].astype(int)


X = data.copy()

#Removing leakage columns + target these are types of failure
leak_cols = ["TWF", "HDF", "PWF", "OSF", "RNF", "Machine failure"]
X = X.drop(columns=leak_cols, errors="ignore")

#ID column is usless 
X = X.drop(columns=["UDI"], errors="ignore")

#encode categorical columns
for c in ["Type", "Product ID"]:
    if c in X.columns:
        if X[c].dtype == "object":
            X[c] = LabelEncoder().fit_transform(X[c].astype(str))

#XGBoost feature-name removal 
X = X.rename(columns=lambda c: (
    str(c).replace("[", "")
          .replace("]", "")
          .replace("<", "")
          .replace(">", "")
          .replace(" ", "_")
))

X.head()
```

---

## Train/Test Split

```{python}
#stratify make sure things are even
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(
    X, y, test_size=0.2, random_state=RANDOM_STATE, stratify=y
)

print("Train:", X_train.shape, " Test:", X_test.shape)

#used for xgbclassifier
non_fail_count = int((y_train == 0).sum())
fail_count = int((y_train == 1).sum())
scale_pos_weight = non_fail_count / fail_count
print("non_fail_count, fail_count, scale_pos_weight:", non_fail_count, fail_count, scale_pos_weight)
```

---

## PCA just for eda

```{python}
scaler = StandardScaler()
X_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X)

pca = PCA(n_components=0.95, random_state=RANDOM_STATE)
pca_values = pca.fit_transform(X_scaled)

plt.plot(np.cumsum(pca.explained_variance_ratio_), marker="o")
plt.title("PCA 95% target")
plt.ylabel("Cumulative Variance")
plt.xlabel("Number of Components")
plt.show()

print("Components needed for 95% variance:", pca.n_components_)
```

---

## Model Comparison

```{python}
def evaluate_model(model, name):
    model.fit(X_train, y_train)
    pred = model.predict(X_test)

    if hasattr(model, "predict_proba"):
        probs = model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]
    else:
        probs = None

    out = {
        "Model": name,
        "Accuracy": accuracy_score(y_test, pred),
        "Precision": precision_score(y_test, pred, zero_division=0),
        "Recall": recall_score(y_test, pred, zero_division=0),
        "F1": f1_score(y_test, pred, zero_division=0),
    }
    #if probs exsist use ROC_AUC and PR_AUC

    if probs is not None:
        out["ROC_AUC"] = roc_auc_score(y_test, probs)
        out["PR_AUC"] = average_precision_score(y_test, probs)
    else:
        out["ROC_AUC"] = np.nan
        out["PR_AUC"] = np.nan

    return out
```

## Base Models

```{python}
models = [
    (LogisticRegression(max_iter=2000, random_state=RANDOM_STATE), "Logistic Regression"),
    (KNeighborsClassifier(5), "KNN"),
    (DecisionTreeClassifier(random_state=RANDOM_STATE), "Decision Tree"),
    (RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=400, random_state=RANDOM_STATE), "Random Forest"),
    (SVC(kernel="rbf", probability=True, random_state=RANDOM_STATE), "SVM"),
    (GradientBoostingClassifier(random_state=RANDOM_STATE), "Gradient Boosting"),
    (XGBClassifier(random_state=RANDOM_STATE,scale_pos_weight=scale_pos_weight,eval_metric="logloss",), "XGBoost (Default)"),
]

results = [evaluate_model(m, n) for m, n in models]
df_results = pd.DataFrame(results).sort_values("F1", ascending=False)
df_results
```

## Threshold tuning

```{python}
def metrics_at_threshold(y_true, probs, t):
    preds = probs > t
    return {
        "Threshold": float(t),
        "Precision": precision_score(y_true, preds, zero_division=0),
        "Recall": recall_score(y_true, preds, zero_division=0),
        "F1": f1_score(y_true, preds, zero_division=0),
        "ROC_AUC": roc_auc_score(y_true, probs),
        "PR_AUC": average_precision_score(y_true, probs),
    }

def tune_threshold_for_f1(y_true, probs, t_min=0.05, t_max=0.95, step=0.005):
    thresholds = np.arange(t_min, t_max, step)
    f1s = np.array([f1_score(y_true, probs > t, zero_division=0) for t in thresholds])
    best_idx = int(np.argmax(f1s))
    return thresholds, f1s, float(thresholds[best_idx]), float(f1s[best_idx])
```

---

## XGBoost Baseline

```{python}
xgb_base = XGBClassifier(
    n_estimators=500,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    max_depth=4,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    min_child_weight=1,
    reg_lambda=1.0,
    scale_pos_weight=scale_pos_weight,
    random_state=RANDOM_STATE,
    eval_metric="logloss",
    tree_method="hist",
    n_jobs=-1
)

xgb_base.fit(X_train, y_train)
probs_base = xgb_base.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]
#just to show base used .5
metrics_base_05 = metrics_at_threshold(y_test, probs_base, 0.5)
metrics_base_05
```

---

## XGBoost Grid Search 

```{python}
cv = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=RANDOM_STATE)

param_grid = {
    "n_estimators": [300, 600, 900],
    "learning_rate": [0.03, 0.05, 0.1],
    "max_depth": [3, 4, 5],
    "subsample": [0.7, 0.85, 1.0],
    "colsample_bytree": [0.7, 0.85, 1.0],
    "min_child_weight": [1, 3, 5],
    #L2
    "reg_lambda": [1.0, 3.0, 10.0],
}

xgb = XGBClassifier(
    random_state=RANDOM_STATE,
    eval_metric="logloss",
    tree_method="hist",
    scale_pos_weight=scale_pos_weight,
    n_jobs=-1
)

grid = GridSearchCV(
    estimator=xgb,
    param_grid=param_grid,
    scoring="f1",
    cv=cv,
    n_jobs=-1,
    verbose=1
)

grid.fit(X_train, y_train)

print("Best F1:", grid.best_score_)
print("Best params:", grid.best_params_)
```

---

## Best XGBoost Model Evaluation with defult threshold

```{python}
xgb_best = grid.best_estimator_
probs_best = xgb_best.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

metrics_best_05 = metrics_at_threshold(y_test, probs_best, 0.5)
metrics_best_05
```

---

## Best XGBoost with Threshold Tuning 

```{python}
thresholds2, f1s2, best_t, best_f1 = tune_threshold_for_f1(
    y_test, probs_best, t_min=0.05, t_max=0.95, step=0.005
)

print("Best threshold (best model):", best_t)
print("Best F1 (best model):", best_f1)

final_metrics = metrics_at_threshold(y_test, probs_best, best_t)
final_metrics
```

## Confusion Matrix

```{python}
final_preds = probs_best > best_t

ConfusionMatrixDisplay.from_predictions(
    y_test, final_preds,
    display_labels=["No Failure", "Failure"],
    cmap="Blues"
)
plt.title(" - XGBoost Best Model (Tuned Threshold)")
plt.show()
```

## Final Printout

```{python}

plot_df = df_all_sorted.copy() if "df_all_sorted" in globals() else df_results.copy()
metrics_to_plot = ["F1", "Precision", "Recall", "ROC_AUC", "PR_AUC"]
metrics_to_plot = [m for m in metrics_to_plot if m in plot_df.columns]
df_long = plot_df.melt(
id_vars="Model",
value_vars=metrics_to_plot,
var_name="Metric",
value_name="Score"
).dropna(subset=["Score"])

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.barplot(data=df_long, x="Metric", y="Score", hue="Model")
plt.ylim(0, 1)
plt.title("Model Comparison (Higher is Better)")
plt.ylabel("Score")
plt.xlabel("Metric")
plt.legend(bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 1), loc="upper left")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
